description_en: Transfers a resource to a different resource group
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka change-resource-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs20000 --new-resource-group-id rg-ac000000000007q --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource that you want to tag. Only instance-level resources are supported.

Example: If the instance ID is alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx, the resource ID is alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx
parameters.help_zh:
需要打标的资源ID 。目前仅支持实例级别。

例如：实例ID为alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx，则资源ID为alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to transfer the cloud resource instance.

A resource group is a mechanism for managing resources by group within an Alibaba Cloud account. Resource groups help you resolve complex issues such as resource grouping and authorization management within a single cloud account. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.help_zh:
需要移入云资源实例的资源组ID。

资源组是在阿里云账号下进行资源分组管理的一种机制，资源组能够帮助您解决单个云账号内的资源分组和授权管理等复杂性问题。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94475.html
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success

NewResourceGroupId.description_en: The new resource group ID. You can view available resource groups in the Resource Group console
NewResourceGroupId.description_zh: 新的资源组ID，可在资源组控制台查看可用资源组

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
